title: Rows encoding the sampled adjacency matrix
statement: For natural numbers $n,p,k$ and bit strings $w,r$, form an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix by reading the bit of $w$ at position $in+j$ for entry $(i,j)$. From $r$, take the block of $k$ bits beginning at position $(in+j)k$ for each entry, interpret it as a natural number, and reduce modulo $p$. The matrix over the integers modulo $p$ whose entries are these reduced block values when the corresponding Boolean entry is $1$, and zero otherwise, equals the resulting masked sample matrix.
